# Medical Technology Schools

> A comprehensive directory of accredited medical technology degree programs, certifications, and career pathways across laboratory science, biomedical technology, healthcare administration, and clinical specialties.

Medical Technology Schools provides prospective students with curated information about degree programs, certifications, and career outcomes in medical technology and healthcare fields. The site aggregates accreditation standards, professional credentials, and educational pathways from entry-level technician programs through advanced specialist roles.

## Key Topics

- Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS)
- Medical Lab Technician (MLT)
- Biomedical Technician (BMET)
- Health Information Management (HIM)
- Medical Billing & Coding
- Healthcare Administration
- Health Informatics
- Biotechnology
- Radiologic Technologist
- Respiratory Therapist
- Professional Certification
- Career Pathways
- Online Degree Programs
- Associate Degree Programs
- Healthcare Education

## Laboratory & Clinical Science Programs

- [Medical Laboratory Scientist Schools - MLS Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/medical-lab-scientist): MLS program directory with accredited degrees and certificate options.
- [Schools with Medical Laboratory Technician Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/medical-lab-technician): MLT program finder for laboratory technician education and training.
- [Biomedical Technician Schools - BMET Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/biomedical-technician): BMET program directory with AAMI and ABET accreditation info.
- [Radiologic Technologist Schools - Radiology Tech Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/radiologic-technologist): Radiologic technologist programs with ASRT certification requirements.
- [Respiratory Therapist Schools - CRT/RRT Education](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/respiratory-therapist): Respiratory therapist programs with CRT/RRT credential preparation.

## Science & Biomedical Degree Programs

- [Biology Programs, including Microbiology and Biochemistry](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/biological-sciences): Biology, microbiology, and biochemistry degree program directory.
- [Biomedical Science Degree Programs - On-campus & Online](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/biomedical-science): Biomedical science degrees online and on-campus with career outcomes.
- [Biotechnology Degree Programs: Campus & Online Degrees](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/biotechnology): Biotechnology program finder with genetic engineering specializations.
- [Health Science Degree Programs (Health Sciences)](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/health-sciences): Health science degree programs online, hybrid, and on-campus.

## Healthcare Administration & Information Management

- [Healthcare Administration Degrees Online](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/healthcare-administration): Healthcare administration degree programs with career and tuition info.
- [Health Information Management (HIM) Degree Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/health-information-management): HIM degree programs with RHIA certification and online options.
- [Schools with Health Informatics Degree Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/health-informatics): Health informatics programs with hybrid and online degree options.
- [Medical Billing & Coding Schools (MC/B) - ICD-10 & CPT](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/medical-coder): Medical billing and coding programs with ICD-10 and CPT training.

## Clinical Support & Allied Health Programs

- [Medical Assistant Schools](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/medical-assistant): Medical assistant program directory with certifications and career info.
- [Schools with Pharmacy Tech Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/pharmacy-technician): Pharmacy technician program finder with CPhT certification training.
- [Audiologist & Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) Programs](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/audiologist-and-speech-language-pathologist): Audiologist and SLP programs with ASHA accreditation information.
- [Nutritionist Schools & Certification | Dietitian Degree](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/nutritionist): Nutritionist and registered dietitian degree programs and certifications.

## Financial Aid & Scholarships

- [50 Medical Science & Technology Scholarships](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/medical-lab-scientist/50-medical-science-tech-scholarships): Comprehensive guide to 50 medical technology scholarships for 2026.
- [10 Anesthesiology Scholarships](https://www.medicaltechnologyschools.com/anesthesia-technician/10-anesthesiology-scholarships): Guide to anesthesiology scholarships for technicians and assistants.
